Scope: [the paths this work may write, space separated, on this line]

[What is wrong, in a paragraph or two. Not what to build: what is wrong today,
so that somebody can disagree with the problem before arguing about the answer.]

[The evidence. Where the evidence is a number, paste the command that produced
it and its output, run against the reference a reader will have rather than
against your working tree. Where a claim cannot be backed by a command, write it
as a claim and say so, because verified, not measured and not evaluated on this
route are three different statements.]

## What to add

[What the change is. Where it depends on a decision file under
`docs/decisions/`, name that file rather than restating what it says.]

## Done when

- [One condition per line, each one something a reader can check.]
- [Where a condition is a guard, it includes the demonstration that the guard
  bites: what was broken deliberately, and that it went red and then green.]
- [Where a condition depends on an unanswered entry of #2, say so here, because
  that makes this issue blocked rather than open.]
